Flèches ou ZQSD : avancer et creuser · ↑: Arrows or ZQSD: move forward and dig · ↑: move up (consume) · 1 2 3: improvements (on the surface)
Jeu de forage : creuse à gauche, à droit: A drilling game: dig left, right or down through a randomly generated 87-metre mine, collect copper, iron, silver, gold, ruby and sapphire, more valuable the deeper you go, and climb back to sell them at the surface where the tank refills on its own. Upgrade the tank, hold and drill for hard rock; lava and running out of fuel cost you your hold.
Les achats se font à la surface: Purchases are made on the surface
Plus on descend, plus les minerais valen: The further down you go, the more expensive the ores are: copper, iron, silver, gold, ruby, sapphire. Hard rock requires a better drill, lava returns to the surface losing its hold.
Soute pleine : remonte vendre: Hold full: goes back to sell
À la surface, tout se vend et le plein s: On the surface, everything is sold and the stock fills itself.
